technical-summary: Added dependency-aware skip gates to optional ACP, Playwright, OpenCode, and Pi CLI tests so the baseline reports unavailable external dependencies as skips instead of false failures.
user-summary-candidate: Made optional-provider tests report clean skips when their external SDKs or CLIs are unavailable.
